bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Ness Church in Litchfield.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HISTORIC NESS CHURCH OF LITCHFIELD. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to repair and preserve the cultural and historic Ness Church in Litchfield. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Ness Church in Litchfield.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HISTORIC NESS CHURCH OF LITCHFIELD.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to repair and preserve the cultural and historic Ness Church in Litchfield.
